facts.business: Piotex Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of polyester chips and filaments, which are crude-oil derivatives, with exposure to export markets.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 34 regarding an income tax demand of ₹5.06 crore for Assessment Year 2024-25, which the Company is contesting; no provision made. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Commodity Price Risk: Raw materials like polyester chips and filaments are crude-oil derivatives.
Currency Risk: Export receivables are subject to forex fluctuations.
Credit Risk: Delays in receivables from domestic and overseas clients.
Environmental Compliance Risk: Non-compliance with stringent pollution control norms can attract penalties.
